d:
A true love song with "Mausam Ki Tarah", a soulful romantic melody from the blockbuster film 'JAANWAR'. Beautifully sung by Manhar Udhas and Alka Yagnik, this timeless song is filled with love, longing, and unforgettable emotions. Featuring Akshay Kumar and Karisma Kapoor, the song is enhanced by the melodious music of Anand- Milind, with heartfelt lyrics by Sameer Anjaan.
Movie: Jaanwar (1999)
Singers: Manhar Udhas & Alka Yagnik
Music: Anand-Milind
Lyrics: Sameer
Starring: Akshay Kumar & Karisma Kapoor
Directed by - Suneel Darshan
